excerpts.text:
RFC 9110 section 9 defines eight methods and classifies each as safe (read only in intent) and idempotent (repeating it has the same intended effect as sending it once):

| Method | Purpose | Safe | Idempotent |

| CONNECT | Establish a tunnel to the server named by the target | no | no |
| OPTIONS | Describe the communication options for the target | yes | yes |
| TRACE | Message loop back test along the path | yes | yes |
